# f5xc_appstack_site (Data Source)

App Stack site defines a required parameters that can be used in CRUD, to create and manage an App Stack site.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Example: Appstack Site - Full

data "f5xc_appstack_site" "example" {
  name      = f5xc_appstack_site.example.name
  namespace = f5xc_appstack_site.example.namespace
}
```

### Nested Schema for `network_cfg_choice.custom_network_config`

Read-Only:

- `bgp_peer_address` (String) bgp_peer_address Optional bgp peer address that can be used as parameter for BGP configuration when BGP is configured to fetch BGP peer address from site Object. This can be used to change peer address per site in fleet.
- `bgp_peer_address_v6` (String) bgp_peer_address_v6 Optional bgp peer IPv6  address that can be used as parameter for BGP configuration when BGP is configured to fetch BGP peer IPv6  address from site Object. This can be used to change peer IPv6  address per site in fleet.
- `bgp_router_id` (String) bgp_router_id Optional bgp router id that can be used as parameter for BGP configuration when BGP is configured to fetch BGP router ID from site object.
- `forward_proxy_choice` (Attributes) Manage Forward Proxy Manage Forward Proxy for this site (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--network_cfg_choice--custom_network_config--forward_proxy_choice))
- `global_network_choice` (Attributes) Connect to Global Network Select global networks to connect to site local network (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--network_cfg_choice--custom_network_config--global_network_choice))
- `interface_choice` (Attributes) Select Interface Config Select how interfaces are configured for this site (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--network_cfg_choice--custom_network_config--interface_choice))

- `outside_nameserver` (String) outside_nameserver Optional DNS server V4 IP to be used for name resolution in local network
- `outside_nameserver_v6` (String) outside_nameserver_v6 Optional DNS server V6 IP to be used for name resolution in local network
- `outside_vip` (String) Common V4 VIP Optional common virtual V4 IP  across all nodes to be used as automatic VIP for site local network.
- `outside_vip_v6` (String) Common V6 VIP Optional common virtual V6 IP across all nodes to be used as automatic VIP for site local network.
- `site_mesh_group_choice` (Attributes) Site Mesh Group Connection Type Select how the site mesh group needs to be connected (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--network_cfg_choice--custom_network_config--site_mesh_group_choice))
- `slo_choice` (Attributes) Site Local Network Select to configure site local network (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--network_cfg_choice--custom_network_config--slo_choice))
- `tunnel_dead_timeout` (Number) tunnel_dead_timeout Time interval, in millisec, within which any ipsec / ssl connection from the site going down is detected. When not set (== 0), a default value of 10000 msec will be used.
- `vip_vrrp_mode` (List of String) vip_vrrp_mode Optional VIP VRRP advertisement mode. This controls the ARP behavior for  Common VIP addresses, when it is configured. When turned on, the Master VER would advertise gratuitous ARPs and would respond to ARP queries for these addresses. When turned off, ARP responses are not given by VER. If BGP is configured, common VIP addresses will be advertised by BGP. This is irrespective of the vrrp mode. When Outside VIP / Inside VIP are configured, it is recommended to turn on vrrp and also configure BGP.

- `ethernet_interface` (Attributes) Ethernet Interface Ethernet interface configuration. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--network_cfg_choice--custom_network_config--interface_choice--interface_list--interfaces--interface_choice--ethernet_interface))
- `tunnel_interface` (Attributes) Tunnel Interface Template Tunnel interface, Ipsec tunnels to other networking devices. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--network_cfg_choice--custom_network_config--interface_choice--interface_list--interfaces--interface_choice--tunnel_interface))

### Nested Schema for `network_cfg_choice.custom_network_config.interface_choice.interface_list.interfaces.interface_choice.dedicated_interface`

Read-Only:

- `device` (String) Device Name of the device for which interface is configured. Use wwan0 for 4G/LTE.
- `monitoring_choice` (Attributes) Select Link Quality Monitoring configuration Link Quality Monitoring configuration for a network interface. When enabled, VER will send probes on the network interface to monitor quality of the link. Links are assigned a score based on the result of probes. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--network_cfg_choice--custom_network_config--interface_choice--interface_list--interfaces--interface_choice--dedicated_interface--monitoring_choice))
- `mtu` (Number) Maximum Packet Size (MTU) Maximum packet size (Maximum Transfer Unit) of the interface When configured, mtu must be between 512 and 9000
- `node_choice` (Attributes) Select Node Independent or Node Specific Interface Cluster configuration will apply to a given device on all nodes of the site. Node configuration will apply to a given device on a specific node. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--network_cfg_choice--custom_network_config--interface_choice--interface_list--interfaces--interface_choice--dedicated_interface--node_choice))
- `primary_choice` (Attributes) Primary Interface Select if this interface is primary interface, only one interface can be primary in a given fleet (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--network_cfg_choice--custom_network_config--interface_choice--interface_list--interfaces--interface_choice--dedicated_interface--primary_choice))
- `priority` (Number) Priority Priority of the network interface when multiple network interfaces are present in outside network Greater the value, higher the priority

Read-Only:

- `monitor` (Boolean) Monitoring enabled Link Quality Monitoring parameters. Choosing the option will enable link quality monitoring.
- `monitor_disabled` (Boolean) Monitoring disabled Link quality monitoring disabled on the interface.

<a id="nestedatt--offline_survivability_mode"></a>
### Nested Schema for `offline_survivability_mode`

Read-Only:

- `offline_survivability_mode_choice` (Attributes) offline_survivability_mode_choice Offline Survivability allows the Site to continue functioning normally without traffic loss during periods of connectivity loss to the Regional Edge (RE) or the Global Controller (GC). When this feature is enabled, a site can continue to function as is with existing configuration for upto 7 days, even when the site is offline. The certificates needed to keep the services running on this site are signed using a local CA. Secrets would also be cached locally to handle the connectivity loss. When the mode is toggled, services will restart and traffic disruption will be seen. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--offline_survivability_mode--offline_survivability_mode_choice))

<a id="nestedatt--offline_survivability_mode--offline_survivability_mode_choice"></a>

Read-Only:

- `enable_offline_survivability_mode` (Boolean) Enable Offline Survivability Mode
- `no_offline_survivability_mode` (Boolean) Disable Offline Survivability Mode

### Nested Schema for `storage_cfg_choice.custom_storage_config.storage_class_choice.storage_class_list.storage_classes.device_choice.hpe_storage`

Read-Only:

- `allow_mutations` (String) allowMutations mutation can override specified parameters
- `allow_overrides` (String) allowOverrides PVC can override specified parameters
- `dedupe_enabled` (Boolean) dedupeEnabled Indicates that the volume should enable deduplication.
- `description` (String) Description The SecretName parameter is used to identify name of secret to identify backend storage's auth information
- `destroy_on_delete` (Boolean) destroyOnDelete Indicates the backing Nimble volume (including snapshots) should be destroyed when the PVC is deleted
- `encrypted` (Boolean) encrypted Indicates that the volume should be encrypted.
- `folder` (String) folder The name of the folder in which to place the volume.
- `limit_iops` (Number) limitIops The IOPS limit of the volume.
- `limit_mbps` (Number) limitMbps The IOPS limit of the volume.
- `performance_policy` (String) performancePolicy The name of the performance policy to assign to the volume.
- `pool` (String) pool The name of the pool in which to place the volume.
- `protection_template` (String) protectionTemplate The name of the performance policy to assign to the volume.
- `secret_name` (String) Secret Name The SecretName parameter is used to identify name of secret to identify backend storage's auth information
- `secret_namespace` (String) Secret Namespace The SecretNamespace parameter is used to identify name of namespace where secret resides
- `sync_on_detach` (Boolean) syncOnDetach Indicates that a snapshot of the volume should be synced to the replication partner each time it is detached from a node.
- `thick` (Boolean) thick Indicates that the volume should be thick provisioned.

Read-Only:

- `selector` (Map of String) Selector Using the Selector field, each StorageClass calls out which virtual pool(s) may be used to host a volume. The volume will have the aspects defined in the chosen virtual pool.
- `storage_pools` (String) Storage Pools The storagePools parameter is used to further restrict the set of pools that match any specified attributes

Read-Only:

- `backend` (String) Backend Defines type of Pure storage backend block or file. The volume will have the aspects defined in the chosen virtual pool.
- `bandwidth_limit` (String) Bandwidth Limit It must be between 1 MB/s and 512 GB/s. Enter the size as a number (bytes must be multiple of 512) or number with a single character unit symbol. Valid unit symbols are K, M, G, representing KiB, MiB, and GiB.
- `iops_limit` (Number) IOPS Limit Enable IOPS limitation. It must be between 100 and 100 million. If value is 0, IOPS limit is not defined.

- `limit_volume_size` (String) Limit Volume Size Fail provisioning if requested volume size is above this value. Not enforced by default.

- `svm` (String) Backend SVM Storage virtual machine to use. Derived if an SVM managementLIF is specified
- `trusted_ca_certificate` (String) Trusted CA Certificate Please Enter Base64-encoded value of trusted CA certificate. Optional. Used for certificate-based auth..
- `username` (String) Username Username to connect to the cluster/SVM

Read-Only:

- `labels` (Map of String) Interface labels Add Labels for this Interface, these labels can be used in firewall policy
- `storage_interface` (Attributes) Interface Configure storage interface for this App Stack site (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--storage_cfg_choice--custom_storage_config--storage_interface_choice--storage_interface_list--storage_interfaces--storage_interface))

Read-Only:

- `device` (String) Device Interface configuration for the ethernet device

- `monitoring_choice` (Attributes) Select Link Quality Monitoring configuration Link Quality Monitoring configuration for a network interface. When enabled, VER will send probes on the network interface to monitor quality of the link. Links are assigned a score based on the result of probes. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--storage_cfg_choice--custom_storage_config--storage_interface_choice--storage_interface_list--storage_interfaces--storage_interface--monitoring_choice))
- `mtu` (Number) Maximum Packet Size (MTU) Maximum packet size (Maximum Transfer Unit) of the interface When configured, mtu must be between 512 and 9000
- `network_choice` (Attributes) Network for this Interface Select virtual network of this interface (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--storage_cfg_choice--custom_storage_config--storage_interface_choice--storage_interface_list--storage_interfaces--storage_interface--network_choice))
- `node_choice` (Attributes) Select Node Independent or Node Specific Interface Cluster configuration will apply to a given device on all nodes of the site. Node configuration will apply to a given device on a given node. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--storage_cfg_choice--custom_storage_config--storage_interface_choice--storage_interface_list--storage_interfaces--storage_interface--node_choice))
- `primary_choice` (Attributes) Primary Interface Select if this interface is primary interface, only one interface can be primary in a given fleet (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--storage_cfg_choice--custom_storage_config--storage_interface_choice--storage_interface_list--storage_interfaces--storage_interface--primary_choice))
- `priority` (Number) Priority Priority of the network interface when multiple network interfaces are present in outside network Greater the value, higher the priority
- `vlan_choice` (Attributes) Select Untagged or VLAN tagged Select if this interface is VLAN tagged or untagged (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--storage_cfg_choice--custom_storage_config--storage_interface_choice--storage_interface_list--storage_interfaces--storage_interface--vlan_choice))
